review:
Alice WonderLuck reimagines Alice in Wonderland with surreal modern art on a 50-line layout. BGaming describes it as combining favourite features from several popular titles, with mystery drops and risk-reward choices built in.

The free spins come with bonus features that change from round to round, so no two bonuses feel quite the same. For a higher stake, the Mystery SpinUP mode adds mystery symbols on every spin. Two buy options are offered where permitted. BGaming rates the game very high volatility with a 10,000x maximum, and the 97% RTP is excellent. Free spins arrive about once every 318 spins on average, so expect plenty of base-game play between bonuses.
